meta.extraction_policy: Maximum useful competitive-exam coverage. Includes definitions, classifications, dated Census figures, constitutional/civic concepts as printed, language families, state–dance associations, religious/social/cultural diversity, unity-in-diversity concepts, statement analysis and evaluation. Excludes arbitrary classroom examples, activity props, album tasks and ICT navigation steps.
source_notes: This file is stored as term-1/unit-7.json to avoid collision with History Units 1–4 and Geography Units 1–2; display_unit=1 keeps the learner-facing Civics unit number correct.
Both English and Tamil 2025 Term I books were used. Civics Unit 1 uses printed pages 192–202, but low-value ICT steps on page 202 are excluded from the quiz bank.
Census figures are explicitly tied to their printed years: 2001 for 122 major/1599 other languages and 2011 for the top-five language percentages.
The textbook’s statement about 22 languages is preserved as a source-specific Eighth Schedule fact. Wording such as 'official languages' is not silently rewritten.
The classical-language chronology is preserved only as the textbook’s listed chronology; the bank does not present the book’s list as a current exhaustive count.
Names of individual classroom students, table props and app-navigation instructions are excluded because they are not competitive-exam useful.
